Excellent! All 107 tests pass. I've successfully added customer ID normalization:

**`normalizeId(id)` in `src/customers.js`:**
- Trims leading and trailing whitespace
- Converts to uppercase
- Returns the normalized ID

**`getCustomer()` updated:**
- Normalizes the input ID before looking it up
- Now works with `'c-001'`, `'C-001'`, `' C-001 '`, etc.

**`createInvoice()` updated:**
- Normalizes the customer ID before validation
- Stores the normalized ID in the invoice
- Input `' c-001 '` → stored as `'C-001'`

**7 new tests in `customers.test.js`:**
- Normalization of various input formats (whitespace, case)
- `getCustomer()` with lowercase and spaces
- Edge cases (null, non-strings)

**4 new tests in `invoices.test.js`:**
- ID normalization in `createInvoice()`
- Mixed case and spaces handling
- Proper storage of normalized IDs

**Example usage:**
```javascript
// These all work and refer to the same customer
getCustomer('C-001')        // ✓ Northwind Studio
getCustomer('c-001')        // ✓ Northwind Studio
getCustomer(' c-001 ')      // ✓ Northwind Studio
getCustomer('  C-001\n')    // ✓ Northwind Studio

// Invoice stores the normalized ID
createInvoice({
  customerId: ' c-003 ',    // Input with spaces
  issueDate: '2026-10-07',
  lines: [...]
})
// → invoice.customerId === 'C-003' (normalized)
```
